episodes.title: Hana Eltringham Whitfield   L Ron Hubbard's Ship Captain   Secret Lives   Scientology   Dianetics
episodes.description:
Please subscribe to my channel  and click the BELL beside the subscribe button for notifications..

This video :
Hana Eltringham was a senior Executive during the early days of the Sea org and spent a lot of face time with Hubbard.  He promoted her to be his Deputy.
Hana was in Scientology for 19 years from March 1965 to August 1984.  She has the most amazing stories.
For those Scientology watchers that are trying to MAKE SENSE out of all of this, this earlier history is invaluable for increased knowledge and understanding.
+++++++++++++++++++++
